BYPASS GROUP - For System Administrators Only
Users in this group have COMPLETE BYPASS of ALL warehouse restrictions: - Record Rules explicitly exclude this group (unrestricted SQL access) - Python Constraints check for this group and skip validation - Same permissions as before module installation
This group is automatically assigned to all users with base.group_system. See: base.group_system has this group in implied_ids.
DO NOT manually assign this group to non-administrators. This would give them unrestricted access to all warehouses.

Base restriction group for warehouse access control.
Provides foundational warehouse restrictions: - Filters stock.picking.type by warehouse.user_ids - Filters stock.location by user.location_ids (blacklist) - Filters stock.warehouse by user_ids - Filters stock.picking by warehouse assignment
CRITICAL - ADMINISTRATOR BYPASS: ================================ System Administrators (base.group_system) are AUTOMATICALLY EXCLUDED: - NOT auto-assigned during installation (see hooks.py) - NOT auto-assigned when creating new admin users (see res_users.py) - Python constraints check for base.group_system and skip validation - Record Rules ONLY apply to users WITH this group
Result: Administrators have UNRESTRICTED warehouse access by default.
WARNING: If you MANUALLY assign this group to an administrator, they WILL be subject to restrictions. This is NOT recommended. Use warehouse.user_ids to grant selective access instead.
This group is HIDDEN and automatically assigned when users receive Source Only or Full restriction groups via inheritance.
DO NOT assign this group directly to users. Use: - Source Only: For regional managers (source validation only) - Full: For warehouse operators (source + destination validation)

Internal group for security record rules.
This group is used to identify users who should see ONLY their own permission records. System administrators (base.group_system) are NOT assigned to this group, allowing them to bypass the "Own Records" restriction.
Auto-assigned to: - All inventory users EXCEPT system administrators
Used by: - warehouse_user_permission_rule_own (Own Records rule)
DO NOT manually assign this group.

Users in this group can CONFIGURE warehouse permissions.
Permissions: - Create/modify/delete warehouse.user.permission records - Access centralized permission matrix view - Configure per-warehouse user permissions
Use case: Warehouse managers, HR managers who assign user permissions.
Note: This group automatically implies stock.group_stock_manager to ensure managers can access configuration menus.

Delegated permission management for warehouse supervisors.
Users in this group can: - CREATE permission records for OTHER users (not themselves) - ONLY for warehouses where THEY have access (permission exists) - ONLY grant permissions EQUAL TO OR LESS THAN their own
Cannot: - Grant permissions to themselves (escalation prevention) - Grant Full Control if they don't have Full Control - Create permissions for warehouses they don't have access to - Delete or modify permissions created by administrators
Use case: Regional warehouse supervisor who needs to grant access to their team members for warehouses they manage.
Security: Python constraints prevent privilege escalation.
